subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
(c)  A manufacturing concern reported a net loss of ` 4,20,000 as per the Cost
Accounts for the year ended 31st March, 2026. Upon scrutiny of both sets of
accounts, the following differences were identified:
Sr.
No.
Particulars
Amount
(`)
(i)
Profit on sale of investments (Financial Accounts only)
55,000
(ii)

70,000
(iii)

30,000
(iv)
Depreciation overcharged in Cost Accounts
90,000
(v)

65,000
(vi)
Bad debts written-off (Financial Accounts only)
1,10,000
(vii) Over-valuation of closing stock in Cost Accounts
40,000
You are required to:
(i)  Prepare a Reconciliation Statement.
(ii)  Ascertain the net profit / (loss) as per the Financial Accounts. (4 Marks)
